The brand is Fancy Feast, not Friskies; "cats ask for it by name" is Fancy Feast's long-running slogan, and my earlier answer was wrong. I'm working from memory and haven't checked the current wording, and Fancy Feast is also a Purina brand. Cat Chow is the other option on the team note, but it doesn't match this slogan.
